name: obsidian-skills
description: Nine self-contained Agent Skills for Obsidian vault work: Obsidian-flavoured Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, Mermaid, visual form selection, the official CLI, Web Clipper, vault diagnosis, and vault sync. Version 0.1.0 is a public prerelease. It is the native half of the secondbrain-skills collection; the eleven knowledge packages are listed here as each one lands.

interface.shortDescription: Nine Obsidian Agent Skills: Markdown, Bases, Canvas, Mermaid, visualize, CLI, Clipper, doctor, sync.
interface.longDescription: obsidian-skills packages nine independent Agent Skills for working inside an Obsidian vault. Each one is a portable SKILL.md package under skills/ with its own references, and each owns exactly its named feature: obsidian-markdown (wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties), obsidian-bases (Bases database views), obsidian-canvas (JSON Canvas documents), obsidian-mermaid (Mermaid diagrams), obsidian-visualize (choosing the right visual form for a note), obsidian-cli (the official Obsidian CLI), obsidian-clipper (the Obsidian Web Clipper), obsidian-doctor (vault and plugin diagnosis), and obsidian-sync (vault sync). This plugin is a distribution container only: there is no router skill, no dispatcher, and no shared runtime, so the host loads whichever package matches the task. Version 0.1.0 is a public prerelease and is installed from a repository or local marketplace rather than the public plugin directory. Native install and fresh-load have been verified on Claude Code in an isolated project scope only; every other runtime install, including this one, is unverified.
